Detailed 18-month phased plan with budget, testing gates, bias audits, rollout; addresses underlying time-saving need.
FADP Art. 21 correctly cited; human review on appeal mandated; substance accurate despite other fabricated citations.
AI shows reasons and confidence; letters include appeal rights, deadlines, oral hearing; immutable audit logs.
